guidelines.detail: same as LRN-036 (The description specifies concurrent work, then an activity that follows one concurrent activity but is independent of the other. The missing branch flows support the structural mismatch. LRN-036 already covers modeling concurrent branches and synchronizing before a later step that requires both.)

refines FID-01 (The description explicitly includes a choice among alternatives and specifies its order and independence from payment activities, while the generated model has no counterpart for that activity. This specializes FID-01's general requirement to model every distinct activity.)

same as LRN-036 (The description specifies concurrent or independent work, and the missing gateways and flows show that the generated model did not represent the parallel branches and their synchronization. LRN-036 already gives essentially the same guidance.)

refines SUB-05 (The description explicitly requires a new delivery for every return. The missing return-to-gateway and gateway-to-delivery flows, together with the missing gateway, support modeling that repeated follow-up explicitly. SUB-05 already covers explicit repetition, while this guideline clarifies that the required follow-up must occur for each occurrence.)

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that one activity continues while another activity occurs before a later step: Model the concurrent activities as parallel branches, then synchronize them before a later step that depends on both being complete.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says an activity must occur after one of several concurrent activities but is independent of the other concurrent activity or activities

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that a participant must choose among alternatives as part of the process: Model the choice explicitly as an activity in the flow, preserving its stated order and dependencies on other activities.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that a participant must choose among alternatives as part of the process

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description says that an activity occurs for every occurrence of an event or condition, and that another activity must follow each occurrence: Model the repeated activity and its required follow-up with a loop or return flow so that every occurrence leads to the follow-up activity.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says that an activity occurs for every occurrence of an event or condition, and that another activity must follow each occurrence
